title: 第15章 处境堪忧的慧姐

content_zh:
内室这边凌嬷嬷在一旁劝道：“表姑娘这就不对了，我们大夫人为了姑娘一天一夜都没有休息好了，姑娘怎么就忘了从前夫人的好呢？”
“你是谁？你是主子是我的长辈吗？我是叶家的孩子，需要叶家的长辈教养，你是奴婢吗？谁家的奴婢如此不知礼数？竟敢妄议主子，家规果然不严！”慧姐言辞犀利的刺得凌嬷嬷哑口无言。
凌嬷嬷跟着大夫人在内院风风雨雨的二十多年了，从没有被如此质疑过，瞬间老脸如铁板烧一般通红难堪，想争辩几句，想着这叶表姑娘不通俗务，不争辩吧真是丢人！
凌嬷嬷的嘴巴几张几合，最后大夫人道：“凌嬷嬷没有规矩了吗？还不赶快下去！”
凌嬷嬷如丧家之犬一般滚到了屋外，大夫人还耐心的道：“慧姐都是这起子奴才不经事，怠慢了慧姐，莫往心里去，回头大舅母会教训她这没规矩的玩意的，你现在就养好身子，记不起来也没关系，大舅母给你找最好的大夫，一定会治好你的知道吗？”
大夫人的话音刚落，卢代蓉一根筋的毛病又犯了，这下更为直接的道：“哎，我娘说的你就听着就是了，我娘就是你娘，瞧我娘多关心你，不过慧姐你有了这么好的玉佩，怎么都不和我说一声呢？真不够意思，日后不带你玩了，除非……这块玉佩你给我吧！”
说着还要伸手，这回被秀雁直接拦下道：“四姑娘你这是做什么？我们姑娘还病着，这块玉佩是我们叶家的家传玉佩，难道四姑娘是打算明抢吗？”
秀雁的声音高高的，比以往都高，震得旁边的大夫人耳朵都嗡嗡的响，暗道一声不好，外面还有那么多小蹄子在看戏，这会子要是强抢玉佩的名声传出去了，可不好了。
大夫人立刻拉着卢代蓉道：“蓉姐，跟娘回去，你表妹刚醒，有些事情不记得，对你还不熟悉，走吧！”
“不走，娘那块玉佩明明是我看中的，凭什么不要回来，她在咱们家吃喝住用哪一样不要花销，不就是一个破玉佩吗，还这样扭扭捏捏的，咱们家难道就白养着她不成！”
本来慧姐不打算多说，让这些神经病滚出去算了，这会子慧姐是真的生气了，真以为自己什么都不知道这府里到底谁养着谁呢？
故此慧姐在秀雁的搀扶下依靠着枕头半坐起来，慧姐感觉惊奇的是，虽然浑身还是很疼，但是却不影响力气，她抓起床上的靠枕扔出去道：“全部闭嘴滚出去！”
说完这句话，慧姐又躺回了床上直喘气，脸色也通红，秀雁心疼的道：“大夫人四姑娘，你们这是要逼死我们家姑娘吗？四姑娘说的什么话，我们家姑娘在卢家可不是白白吃饭的，我们家老爷每年几千两银子的俸禄可都是给了姑娘在卢家花销的，而且旁边那个三进的大院子就是给姑娘一个人住的，难不成我们姑娘都能花完不成，你们欺骗我们姑娘不通俗物，但是骗不了我，大不了我们明天立刻离开，回叶家不住这破地方！”
大夫人一看场面难以控制，就拉着卢代蓉赶快走，可是卢代蓉被秀雁这个奴婢刺激了，府里很多事情她都不知道，哪里知道恨不得整个卢家都是慧姐养着。
卢代蓉这会子激动的道：“娘，我不走，这个贱婢今个一定要和她掰扯清楚，一个奴婢都敢蹬鼻子上脸了，叶沁慧你少在那里装傻，看看你的贱婢敢惹我，吃了雄心豹子胆了，竟然敢惹我，娘你别拦着我，今天要个这个贱婢好看。”
大夫人和卢代蓉拉扯起来，就在这时，积累了一些力气的慧姐，抓起床边她们刚刚拿来的茶盘，对着这对母女就扔了出去，这些左右都是前主的玩意，看着都闹心，干脆就砸了更闹心的人。
慧姐大声的喝道：“滚滚，全都闭嘴赶紧滚！不然我一把火烧了这破地方！滚！”
“噼里啪啦……”的响声和发怒的慧姐，惊醒了还在拉扯的两个人，此时两个人的衣服上都是茶叶，衣服还在滴滴的都是茶水，十分的狼狈。
这对母女看着满地都是摔碎的茶壶茶杯的碎片，惊吓的看着有些暴力倾向的慧姐，想说什么最后谁也没说灰溜溜的走了。

content_en:
In the inner room, Nanny Ling was admonishing: "My cousin, this is not right. Our eldest wife has not rested all day and night for the sake of the girl. Why has the girl forgotten the kindness of my former wife?"
"Who are you? Are you the master and my elder? I am a child of the Ye family and need to be educated by the elders of the Ye family. Are you a slave? Whose slave is so ignorant of etiquette? How dare you talk about the master? The family rules are really not strict!" Sister Hui's sharp words made Grandma Ling speechless.
Grandma Ling has been with the eldest lady in the inner courtyard for more than 20 years, and she has never been questioned like this. Instantly, her face turned red like a sizzling iron, and she wanted to argue. She thought that this girl Ye Biao was ignorant of ordinary affairs, so it would be a shame not to argue!
Grandma Ling's mouth opened and closed several times, and finally the eldest lady said: "Don't you have any rules, Grandma Ling? Why don't you get down quickly!"
Aunt Ling rolled out of the house like a bereaved dog. The eldest lady said patiently: "Sister Hui is an inconsiderate slave. I neglected Sister Hui. Don't take it to heart. Auntie will teach her a lesson for this unruly thing later. You should take good care of yourself now. It doesn't matter if you don't remember. Auntie will find you the best doctor and he will definitely cure you, you know?"
As soon as the eldest lady finished speaking, Lu Dairong's stubborn problem recurred. This time she said more directly: "Hey, just listen to what my mother said. My mother is your mother. Look how much my mother cares about you. But Sister Hui, you have such a good jade pendant, why don't you tell me? It's really not fun. I won't play with you in the future, unless... give me this jade pendant!"
As he spoke, he extended his hand, but this time Xiuyan stopped him directly and said, "Fourth girl, what are you doing? Our girl is still sick. This jade pendant is an inherited jade pendant of our Ye family. Is it possible that Fourth girl plans to steal it openly?"
Xiuyan's voice was high, higher than before, which made the ears of the lady next to her buzz. She secretly thought, "There are so many little hooves watching the show outside. It would be bad if the reputation of robbing the jade pendant spreads out now."
The eldest lady immediately pulled Lu Derong and said: "Sister Rong, go back with your mother. Your cousin has just woken up. She doesn't remember some things and is not familiar with you yet. Let's go!"
"Don't leave. Mom's jade pendant is obviously my favorite. Why don't you come back? She doesn't have to spend anything on food, drink, and accommodation at our house. Isn't it just a broken jade pendant? She's still coquettishly acting like this. Isn't our family raising her for nothing!"
Originally, Sister Hui didn't plan to say anything more and just let these lunatics get out of here. Now, Sister Hui is really angry. She really thinks that she doesn't know anything about who is raising whom in this house.
Therefore, with Xiuyan's support, Sister Hui half-sited up relying on the pillow. Sister Hui was surprised that although her whole body was still in pain, it did not affect her strength. She grabbed the pillow on the bed and threw it out: "Shut up, everyone, and get out!"
After saying this, Sister Hui lay back on the bed and panted again, her face turned red. Xiuyan said distressedly: "Madam, Miss Four, are you trying to force our girl to death? What did the Fourth Girl say? Our girl does not eat for free in the Lu family. Our master's salary is several thousand taels of silver every year." But they are all given to the girl to spend at Lu’s house, and the big three-in-one courtyard next to it is for the girl to live alone. Is it possible that we girls can’t spend it all? You deceived us girls, but you can’t deceive me. The worst is that we will leave immediately tomorrow and go back to the Ye family and not live in this poor place! "
When the eldest lady saw that the situation was uncontrollable, she pulled Lu Dairong away quickly, but Lu Dairong was stimulated by Xiuyan, a slave. She didn't know many things in the house, and she wished that the entire Lu family was raised by Sister Hui.
Lu Dairong said excitedly: "Mom, I won't leave. This bitch must have a clear break with her now. A slave dares to bite her nose. Ye Qinhui, stop pretending to be stupid. Look at your bitch."This maid dares to provoke me. I am so ambitious that I dare to provoke me. Mother, don’t stop me. I want this cheap maid to look good today. "
The eldest lady and Lu Derong started fighting. At this moment, Sister Hui, who had accumulated some strength, grabbed the tea tray they had just brought from the bedside and threw it at the mother and daughter. These were the toys of the previous owner. They were all upset when they looked at them, so she simply smashed the person who was more upset.
Sister Hui shouted loudly: "Go away, shut up and get out! Otherwise I'll burn this place down! roll! "
The sound of "crackling..." and the angry Sister Hui woke up the two people who were still pulling. At this time, their clothes were covered with tea leaves, and their clothes were still dripping with tea. They were very embarrassed.
The mother and daughter looked at the broken pieces of teapots and cups scattered all over the ground. They looked at the somewhat violent Sister Hui in shock. They wanted to say something, but in the end no one said anything and left in despair.
